svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Saddle (make 2): 8 mm steel, 44 x 34 mm. Turn a 2 mm deep ring

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: groove in its underside, 34 mm across, to locate the spring top.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Straps (make 4): 4 mm steel strip 12 mm wide, 79 mm long.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bottom end: a 6.5 mm hole 5 mm from the end (bolted to the tab).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top end: a 6.5 mm wide slot, 12 mm long, ending 4 mm from the end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: one strap each side of the spring, bolted M6 to the tab and,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: through its slot, to the saddle. The slot lets the spring squash

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: when a wheel rides a bump; when the lever lifts the saddle, the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: top of the slot catches and the straps lift the arm and wheel.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: With the wheels down the saddle bolt sits 4 mm below the slot top.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the saddle slides up and down the slots without binding.
